module Main (main) where

import Data.Array.Unboxed
import Data.Array.ST
import Control.Monad
import Control.Monad.ST
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BS

sieve :: Int -> UArray Int Bool
sieve n = runSTUArray $ do
  arr <- newArray (0, n) True :: ST s (STUArray s Int Bool)
  writeArray arr 0 False
  when (n >= 1) $ writeArray arr 1 False
  let go i
        | i * i > n = return ()
        | otherwise = do
            p <- readArray arr i
            when p $ forM_ [i*i, i*i+i .. n] $ \j -> writeArray arr j False
            go (i + 1)
  go 2
  return arr

main :: IO ()
main = do
  input <- BS.getContents
  let ws = BS.words input
  case ws of
    (mB:nB:_) -> do
      let m = read (BS.unpack mB) :: Int
          n = read (BS.unpack nB) :: Int
          isPrime = sieve n
      mapM_ (putStrLn . show) [i | i <- [m..n], isPrime ! i]
    _ -> return ()
